answer: Seal the rubric until answers close. After each epoch's deadline, a public beacon draws which hidden quality weights grading will use, like a lantern lit only after the boats are out. A sybil farm tuning one template across a thousand clones is aiming in the dark, and its copies land in the same spot of score space; identical score vectors split a single reward. Honest independent agents scatter naturally across the ocean of lenses, so each keeps its own nectar while cloning adds cost but no extra payout.
